title: macOS RC Follow-up
objective: Stage attested native dependency receipts through immutable cache links and keep all macOS addon deployment targets consistent

handoff.summary: SEA dependency receipts can now be staged from an installed native prefix symlink only when it resolves to the exact read-only content-addressed cache payload for that package and workspace-relative prefix. The assembly rechecks the installed link and receipt identity after building. FLINT and graph handwritten addons now obtain their macOS deployment target from the same validated environment-backed helper used by native dependencies instead of hard-coding 13.0.
risks: Focused receipt, adversarial symlink, deployment-target, strict-baselib, and architecture checks pass. Full portable/native/SEA validation is deferred until this shared release fix is independently reviewed and exercised by the clean Apple-silicon release build; the initial Linux validation worktree lacked M4RI before its cache prerequisite was prepared.
next_steps: Independently review the exact cache path and immutability checks, integrate the branch tip, then rerun the full unsigned macOS arm64 release build at the integrated commit and inspect every Mach-O deployment target.
